layout.arrangement: Title centered at top with a yellow slide-number badge at top-right; below, two columns: left column (~45% width) stacks four colored annotation callout boxes vertically; right column (~40% width) holds a full-height Transformer architecture flowchart inside a green-bordered frame subdivided into an Encoder panel (left) and Decoder panel (right).

regions.name: Callout column
regions.content: Four stacked annotation boxes: yellow (decoder input rule), pink (first decoder block note), tan (input positional encoder), tan (output positional encoder)

regions.name: Transformer diagram
regions.content: Green-framed Encoder/Decoder architecture flowchart with embedding, positional encoding, attention, Add & Norm, feed-forward, linear, softmax nodes and red arrows

layout.hierarchy: The red title is the largest/boldest text; the diagram dominates by area (right half, full height); callout boxes are medium bold text; diagram node labels are the smallest; yellow highlights, red block arrows and the red dashed feedback loop are the strongest attention cues inside the diagram.

visual_elements.description: Transformer architecture diagram in a green-bordered rounded frame split into two panels: LEFT panel labeled 'Encoder' (red italic, top-left) with pale peach fill; RIGHT panel labeled 'Decoder' (green italic, top-right) with pale green fill. ENCODER STACK (bottom to top): bold text 'Inputs' with a thick red up block-arrow into tan box 'Input Embedding'; thin black arrow up to a circle containing a ⊕-style symbol labeled 'Positional Encoding' (two-line label at its left); arrow up into tan box 'Multi-Head Attention' whose bottom receives three small letter-circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) all fed from the positional-encoding output (self-attention); arrow up to tan box 'Add & Norm'; arrow up to tan box 'Feed Forward'; arrow up to tan box 'Add & Norm'. A gray circle 'N x' sits at mid-height left of this stack (repeat notation). From the top 'Add & Norm', V (blue) and K (blue) branch rightward into the decoder — these crossing paths are emphasized with a yellow highlight band. DECODER STACK (bottom to top): bold text 'Outputs' (yellow-highlighted) with '(shifted right)' beneath it; thick red up block-arrow into dark-red box 'Output Embedding'; arrow up to a ⊕ circle labeled 'Positional Encoding' (two-line label at its right); arrow up into purple box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' with V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) circles at its bottom; arrow up to tan 'Add & Norm'; arrow up to tan 'Multi-Head Attention' receiving V (blue) and K (blue) from the encoder (yellow-highlighted paths) and Q (red) from below; arrow up to tan 'Add & Norm'; arrow up to tan 'Feed Forward'; arrow up to tan 'Add & Norm'; gray circle 'N x' at right of the stack; arrow up to light-green box 'Linear'; arrow up to light-green box 'Softmax'; arrow up to bold text 'Output Probabilities' with a thick red up block-arrow. A red DASHED curved arrow runs from 'Output Probabilities' down the right edge to 'Outputs (shifted right)' (autoregressive feedback loop). 'Add & Norm' appears 5 times total (2 in encoder, 3 in decoder); 'Feed Forward' 2 times; 'Multi-Head Attention' 2 times; 'N x' 2 times; 'Positional Encoding' 2 times.

imagery: No photographs or illustrations. Icon-like elements only: two circles containing ⊕-style positional-encoding addition symbols (one per panel); nine small colored letter-circles labeled V (blue), K (blue), Q (red); two gray 'N x' repeat badges; thick red block arrows; red dashed curved feedback arrow.
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title ~36-40pt bold, red, centered, with spaced en dash. Callout text ~16-18pt bold, centered, two lines per box. Diagram node labels ~9-11pt regular black; panel labels 'Encoder' and 'Decoder' bold italic; 'Inputs', 'Outputs', 'Output Probabilities' bold. Slide number bold. No all-caps styling, no italics in body callouts, no numbered bullets — the left column uses colored filled rectangles instead of bulleted text.

recreation_brief: 1. Set a 16:9 slide with background #E7E7E7 and add a thin (2pt) dark-gray rectangle border around the slide edge. 2. Add a centered text box at top (~y 6%-17%): 'Encoder – Decoder Transformer', Arial bold 40pt, color #C00000. 3. Add a 0.6-inch yellow (#FFFF00) circle with thin gray outline at top right containing bold '17' (#333333, 14pt). 4. Callout 1: rectangle at x 8%-56%, y 21%-33%, fill #FFFF00, centered bold 18pt #00008B text on two lines: 'Decoder Output (at step “t-1”)' / 'Is supplied as Decoder Input (at step “t”)'. 5. Callout 2: rectangle at x 17%-51%, y 39%-50%, fill #F9A8F0; line 1 'First Decoder Block' bold 18pt #9900CC; line 2 'No Input from Encoder Attention' bold 16pt #C00000. 6. Callout 3: rectangle at x 8%-56%, y 62%-73%, fill #C7A17A; line 1 'Input Positional Encoder' bold 18pt #943634; line 2 '(Position of Input Word within the Input Sequence)' bold 14pt #943634. 7. Callout 4: identical style at y 86%-96% with 'Output Positional Encoder' / '(Position of Output Word within the Output Sequence)'. 8. Diagram frame: rounded rectangle x 59%-97%, y 17%-98%, 2.5pt #00B050 border; inside it place a left panel rectangle (fill #FBE5D6) and right panel rectangle (fill #D8F0D8); add bold italic labels 'Encoder' (#C00000) at the left panel's top-left and 'Decoder' (#00B050) at the right panel's top-right. 9. Build the ENCODER stack bottom-to-top with thin black connectors: bold 'Inputs' + thick red up block-arrow → tan (#C7A17A, border #7B4B2A) box 'Input Embedding' → small circle with ⊕ symbol, two-line label 'Positional Encoding' at its left → tan box 'Multi-Head Attention' with three 0.25-inch circles beneath it fed from the ⊕ circle: V (#0000FF), K (#0000FF), Q (#FF0000), white bold letters → tan 'Add & Norm' → tan 'Feed Forward' → tan 'Add & Norm'. Place a gray (#BFBFBF) circle 'N x' left of the stack at mid-height. 10. Build the DECODER stack bottom-to-top: bold 'Outputs' with a yellow (#FFFF00) highlight rectangle behind it and '(shifted right)' below → thick red up block-arrow → dark-red (#C0504D) box 'Output Embedding' → ⊕ circle with 'Positional Encoding' label at its right → purple (#B28FCE) box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' with V/K/Q circles below → tan 'Add & Norm' → tan 'Multi-Head Attention' → tan 'Add & Norm' → tan 'Feed Forward' → tan 'Add & Norm'; gray 'N x' circle at the stack's right; then light-green (#C5E0B4, border #548235) boxes 'Linear' → 'Softmax' → bold 'Output Probabilities' with a thick red up block-arrow. 11. Cross-connections: from the encoder's top 'Add & Norm' output draw two thin black lines rightward into the decoder 'Multi-Head Attention' bottom, ending in blue V and blue K circles; place a yellow L-shaped highlight rectangle behind these paths (send to back); feed that box's red Q circle from the decoder's own lower stream. 12. Feedback loop: draw a red (#C00000) dashed curved connector from 'Output Probabilities' down outside the right edge to 'Outputs (shifted right)', arrowhead at the bottom. 13. Optionally add faint gray leader lines from callouts 1 and 2 toward the decoder panel.
